Quiz

More quizzes

Mix other quiz types into the same video so it never gets boring. Each extra quiz has its own type, heading and questions, and you choose where it goes. Questions are numbered one after another through the whole video.
Photos: name them after the answer (venus.jpg) and they work in every quiz. If you number them (7a.jpg), the number is the question's place in the whole video. Voice-over: you can record the extra quizzes inside your main voice-over (in video order), or give each extra quiz its own voice file. Its clips then follow its questions wherever they land, and a teal "audio added" bar shows on the Edit timeline.
